proposal_sections.why_these: Selected sites maximize composite heat offset and transit-dependent / senior vulnerability while maintaining >= 2.0 km spacing [P1].
proposal_sections.what_this_displaces: Runner-up candidates either fall within the 2.0 km catchment spacing of a higher-ranked center or serve fewer car-free and senior residents [P1].

limitations: Heat offsets come from a single afternoon Heat Watch campaign.
Catchment distances are straight-line (800 m), not walking-network routes.
The model predicts outdoor ambient heat offset, not indoor temperatures or health outcomes.
Seven years of GHCN station history show interannual variability, not a multi-decade climate trend.
Race and ethnicity are never model or ranking inputs; they appear only in post-hoc equity auditing.
